CustomField.description: When checked, the email alert is sent to all approvers assigned to the step being actioned (the step that triggered this action). For queue-assigned steps, all queue members receive the email. Used only when ActionKind__c = EmailAlert.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sends to the approvers who acted on (or were assigned to) the current step. For a queue assignment, all queue members are resolved and notified individually.
CustomField.label: Notify Current Step Approvers
